name: Jennifer Johnson
source:
Jennifer is the Mother of Susan & Cindy, and is Grandmother to Amie, Kylie, Bree & the MC. As a retired lawyer she is constantly researching what she can possible do to protect her family legally. She has also been keeping a watchful eye on all the ex-partners of her daughters.

[From [url=https://jun1or72.itch.io/lost-found]Itch.io[/url]]
